questions.kp: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.stem: The Great Wall ____ over many centuries by millions of workers.
questions.explain: 长城是“被建造”的，后面还有 by 引出动作执行者，用被动语态；讲的是历史，用一般过去时的被动 was built。
questions.verify: 本单元按“被动语态与主谓一致”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.kp: 现在进行时的被动语态
questions.stem: The road outside our office ____, so we have to go another way this week.
questions.explain: 路是“被修”的，而且修路正在进行，用现在进行时的被动语态 is being + 过去分词。

questions.kp: 被动语态中不定式的 to
questions.stem: The boy was made ____ the room again by his mother.
questions.explain: 主动语态 make sb. do sth. 不带 to，改成被动语态时要把 to 还原：sb. be made to do sth.。最容易误选的是“clean”。

questions.stem: This kind of cloth ____ soft and washes well.
questions.explain: feel 在这里是系动词（摸起来），系动词没有被动语态，用主动形式 feels；后面的 washes well（好洗）也是主动形式表被动意义。

questions.stem: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ satisfied with the result.
questions.explain: neither…nor…、either…or…、not only…but also… 连接主语时，谓语和离它最近的主语一致；students 是复数，用 were。

questions.stem: The number of cars in this city ____ increased rapidly in recent years.
questions.explain: the number of + 复数名词表示“……的数量”，中心词是 number，谓语用单数；a number of（许多）+ 复数名词，谓语用复数。in recent years 要求用现在完成时。

questions.kp: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.stem: English ____ (speak) as a first language in many countries.
questions.explain: English 是“被说”的，陈述的是现在的事实，用一般现在时的被动语态 is + 过去分词 spoken。

questions.kp: 主谓一致：以 -s 结尾的学科名
questions.stem: Physics ____ (be) my favorite subject when I was in high school.
questions.explain: physics、mathematics、news 等虽以 -s 结尾，却是不可数名词，谓语用单数；when I was in high school 表示过去，用 was。
